widgets_values:
## Model Links
[🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

**diffusion_models**

Hybrid fl2va/ref2va models are recommended in reference mode for better performance, as MiniMax has confirmed the released reference weights are flawed and have not released an update. Hybrid fl2va based on your preference (explained on the model card) are recommended. The version with 20-49 layers is a good balance

- [minimax_h3_hybrid_fl2va_ref2va_b20-49-int8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/smhfacct/Minimax-H3-fl2va-ref2va-hybrid-models/tree/main)


**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors)

**turbo_lora**

fl2va/ref2va hybrid model uses the fl2va turbo lora. This one is an 8-step and works well, but there are a bunch out there to choose from.

- [minimax_h3_dmd_fl2va_8step_turbo_pruned.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora-ComfyUI/blob/main/experimental/minimax_h3_dmd_fl2va_8step_turbo_pruned.safetensors)


## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_hybrid_fl2va_ref2va_b20-49-int8.safetensors
│   └── 📂 text_encoders/
│       └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_dmd_fl2va_8step_turbo_pruned.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
